Happy Caturday!

We're celebrating International Cat Day by highlighting your furry companion in Edge of Memories. Explore these gorgeous anime-inspired vistas on the back of your Nekaroo.

Interacting with pillars scattered throughout the environment will unlock Nekaroo exploration, revealing new paths and areas for you to discover. 

Edge of Memories is an action-RPG created by a small French team with a love for JRPGs, old-school action games, and kitties.

Edge of Memories will be available on PlayStation 5 later this year.
